decisions.statement: A turn end writes every pending component from the reads that turn end takes.
The stretch after a turn end is the stretch kept true here.
A seat in that stretch is not running to notice a change of its own.
Every component but the compacting component is maintained here.
The compacting component changes inside a turn and clears by starting the seat.
A run over the whole fleet is cheap enough to take on every change.
A file changing is the only thing that moves this module.
The store watched is the store the run that store triggers reads.
A turn starts in a transcript rather than in a store this module writes.
The folder with every seat's transcript is watched alongside those stores.
A transcript folder is followed no deeper than the transcripts themselves.
A transcript settles for its own stretch rather than the stretch a store settles for.
A transcript settles for the shorter stretch.
This module writes into no transcript folder.
A transcript run triggers no other run.
One component is written.
A reading is taken from every component when somebody asks.
Taking the run twice changes nothing.
A settled run ending is where this leaves for code that moved.
Every run here is whole before it returns, which makes its end a safe point.
A run stopped part way leaves every seat that run reached correct.
A run stopped part way leaves every seat that run did not reach as that seat was.
Loading this code declares its value and takes no run.
Nothing here is read on a tick.
Nothing here decides whether a seat is pending.
A transcript folder appearing after this starts is followed by nothing here.

definition: every seat's pending components kept true as the stores behind them change
